Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 Must be first field in message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following Body Length field up to and including the delimiter preceding the Check Sum field. Must be second field in message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be third field in message. 0=Heartbeat 1=Test Request 2=Resend/Request 3=Reject 4=Sequence Reset 5=Logout 8=Execution Report 9=Order Cancel Reject A=Logon D=New Order Single F=Order Cancel Request G=Order Cancel Replace Request UCC=Trade Cancel/Correct

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender: Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (Target Comp IDfor messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of sender: Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (Target Sub IDfor messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination: ‘BATS’ for messages sent to BZX Exchange. ‘BYXX’ for messages sent to BYX Exchange. ‘EDGX’ for messages sent to EDGX Exchange. ‘EDGA’ for messages sent to EDGA Exchange. (Sender Comp IDfor messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination: ‘TEST’ for messages sent to Cboe test/certification system. ‘PROD’ for messages sent to Cboe production system. (Sender Sub IDfor messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: N=(Default) Y=Indicates a message resend and should be used during FIX Replay. All inbound orders with ‘Y’ will be rejected by Cboe.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT date-time that message was sent.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with Poss Dup Flag=‘Y’, indicates time that message was first sent.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three byte, simple checksum. Always unencrypted, always last field in message.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 0=New 3=Status

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Day-unique id of execution message. Will be zero for Exec Trans Typeof Status (3).

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: ExtendedExecInst
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason for this Execution Report: 0=New (acknowledgment of new order) 1=Partial Fill 2=Fill 3=Done For Day 4=Canceled 5=Replaced 6=Pending Cancel 8=Rejected D=Restated E=Pending Replace Pending Cancel ‘6’ and Pending Replace ‘E’ are only valid for routed orders that have posted to an away market. For Standard FIX Drop, only ‘1’ or ‘2’ will be sent and will always equal Ord Status(39). For Order by Order FIX Drop, all execution information will be sent. Refer to section 6.2.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord ID of the order being accepted, executed or rejected. -or- Cl Ord ID of the cancel or replace request. -or- Cl Ord ID of the order subject to unsolicited cancel (Orig Cl Ord ID will not be present).

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Order Id (supplied by Cboe).

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: State of order. 0=New 1=Partially Filled 2=Filled 3=Done For Day 4=Canceled 5=Replaced 6=Pending Cancel 8=Rejected A=Pending Ack E=Pending Replace For FIX Drop, only ‘1’ or ‘2’ will be sent and will always equal Exec Type (150). For Order by Order FIX Drop, all execution information will be sent.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Copied from order. For Order by Order FIX Drop, all execution information will be sent.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Copied from order. On restatements (150=D) the Order Qtymay be updated (for example, for SWP or CMC restatements).

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: DiscretionAmount
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Copied from order if Time In Forceis GTD (6) or PTD (T).

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity of shares still open for further execution. Will include shares already matched in an earlier session for CMC restatements. Will be zero if order is dead, otherwise will be Order Qty(38)- Cum Qty (14). NNoottee::It is possible for Leaves Qtyto be zero when Exec Type(150) = 5 indicating that the order is dead.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity of shares executed for this order.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Average price of executions for this order weighted by trade size. Zero if Cum Qtyis zero.

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Specific fee code associated with execution. See the Fee Schedule for the respective market for possible values.

Field.Name: AccessFee (effective 02/02/26)
Field.Description: Transaction fee or rebate, inclusive of earned tiers, for the trade. Only present when Exec Type(150) = 1 or Exec Type(150) = 2.

Field.Name: WorkingPrice
Field.Description: Must be enabled at the firm or port level. Only present on Accepted, Replaced, or Restated and only when order is fully or partially booked. If Pricehad to be adjusted to a less aggressive value to avoid crossing the NBBO, the adjusted price will be reported here, otherwise equals Price.

Field.Name: InitialDisplayPrice
Field.Description: Must be enabled at the firm or port level. Only present on Accepted, Replaced, or Restated and only when order is fully or partially booked. If order had to be temporarily displayed at a less aggressive value to avoid locking the NBBO, the initial displayed price will be reported here, otherwise equals Working Price.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares traded on this fill (zero for non-fills). Reports the amount of shares cancelled for Cboe Market Close restatements, which are sent after each matching session cut-off time. Reports the size of Cboe Market Close fills, which are sent after the official closing price is received from the primary listing exchange.. Field.Description: If present, indicates reason for reject or cancel. Format is one letter reason code followed by colon and space followed by free form text message.
